pipeline: nf-core bulk RNA-seq pipeline (FastQC, TrimGalore, STAR v2.7.11, Salmon, DESeq2)
needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables -- part of the batch-1 scaling pass, prioritizing breadth of verified accessions over per-sample depth. Publication metadata pulled from PubMed esummary; not yet manually spot-checked against the full text for every record in this batch. FACT-CHECK (2026-07-10): normal_control_tissue was recorded as not included, but Series_overall_design states tumors were 'compared to normal meninges'; checked individual GSM source_name_ch1 fields directly and confirmed 7 of the 40 samples (GSM8712034-GSM8712040) are labeled 'Patient resected meningies' (normal control) versus 33 labeled 'Patient resected tumor'; corrected to included=true, count=7. FACT-CHECK (2026-07-11): corresponding_author was missing a genuine third corresponding author. Fetched the paper's open-access PMC full text (PMC12749072) directly: three authors are marked corresp="yes" with listed emails -- Zohdy YM (youssef.ismail@emory.edu), Alawieh AM (ali.mostafa.alawieh@emory.edu), and Garzon-Muvdi T (tomas.garzon-muvdi@emory.edu), the paper's last author. All three are present in the live GSE285889 Series_contributor list (16 names total); corrected corresponding_author from just the first two to all three, matching GEO's contributor name format. EXTERNAL RE-VERIFICATION (2026-07-12): reference_genome filled from 'Not reported' to 'hg38' and pipeline from 'Not reported' to the nf-core bulk RNA-seq pipeline (TrimGalore, STAR v2.7.11, Salmon, DESeq2); all 40 GSM records' data_processing state 'Assembly: hg38' and describe this pipeline verbatim. Re-verified normal_control (7 of 40 GSMs labelled 'Patient resected meningies', GSM8712034-8712040), sample_count (40 GSM), platform, dates, and the three corresponding authors (Zohdy, Alawieh, Garzon-Muvdi all carry the author-notes correspondence marker in PMC12749072) against live GEO/PubMed; no further discrepancy. sex/age remain 'Not reported' (no per-sample sex or age field exists in this series' GSM characteristics). DEEP-AUDIT UPDATE (2026-07-14): sample_count was incorrectly recorded as 40, which is the raw GSM library-record count, not the number of distinct biological specimens. Re-pulled all 40 GSM records fresh (acc.cgi?acc=GSE285889&targ=gsm&form=text&view=brief): titles follow a specimen-plus-replicate pattern (e.g. D1-1/D1-2, P2-1/P2-2/P2-3), and every GSM's own Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 states libraries were built 'in 3 technical replicates for each sample.' Enumerating distinct specimen-title prefixes gives exactly 14 distinct specimens: 3 normal-meninges donors (D1, D2, D3; 2-3 replicate libraries each = 7 GSMs) and 11 tumor specimens (P2, P3, P4, P5A, P5B, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10A, P10B; 3 replicate libraries each = 33 GSMs), totaling the 40 deposited GSMs. This is independently corroborated by the peer-reviewed paper's own Methods section (PMC12749072, 'Patient cohort and specimens'): 'A total of 11 meningiomas were included in this study, resected from 9 patients; in two patients, two tumors were simultaneously resected from different anatomical locations... Additionally, 3 normal meninges were resected and included in the analysis: 2 samples were obtained during meningioma resection away from the tumor site, and 1 sample was obtained during a cerebrovascular lesion surgery.' Corrected sample_count from 40 to 14 (11 tumor + 3 normal biological specimens) and normal_control_tissue.count from 7 to 3 (3 distinct normal-donor specimens, not the 7 GSM library records derived from them). patient_count left 'Not reported': the paper gives a clean count for the tumor arm only (9 patients contributing 11 tumors), but whether the 3 normal-meninges specimens come from any of those same 9 patients or from additional, distinct individuals cannot be determined from the live source (2 of the 3 are described only as 'away from the tumor site' during meningioma resection, without stating if patient-matched to the 9; 1 is explicitly a different, non-meningioma cerebrovascular-lesion patient), so a single total patient_count would require guessing and was not filled in.
